visual_enhancers.texture: Paper grain SVG noise overlay with 3% opacity for tactile documentary warmth
visual_enhancers.motion: Scroll reveal via IntersectionObserver with staggered opacity and 20px upward translate transition

accessibility_and_contrast.wcag_compliance: AA Standard (Minimum 4.5:1 ratio for body, 3:1 for large display)
accessibility_and_contrast.text_dark_bg: Text on dark surface (#1E1A17) uses #F9F6F0 (15.8:1 contrast)
accessibility_and_contrast.text_light_bg: Text on light surface (#F9F6F0) uses #1E1A17 (15.2:1 contrast)

testing_guidelines.data_testid_rule: All interactive elements, buttons, links, section containers, and inputs MUST have a descriptive kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all React components in frontend/src use `.js` or `.jsx` file extension. Apply the provided CSS variables and Tailwind classes. Maintain full responsive support from mobile grid-cols-1 to desktop grid-cols-12. Do NOT leave transparent backgrounds under header or overlays.
